fusions.name: Fang of Bedrock
fusions.desc: Hurls a fang of stone that deals 28 rock damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds, then shatters, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Ground-In Grit
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A weapon strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Flat Rock
fusions.desc: Sets a flat stone with a viper under it at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and the viper deals 18 damage to the first enemy to come within 2 tiles and leaves it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Felt Through Flagstones
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
